experiments.primary_result: Demonstrated compiler-enabled physical quantum query advantage on structured search spaces on IBM Heron hardware: query reduction of 2.43x (N=4), 1.73x (N=8), and 1.19x (N=16) across 9/9 individual cases and 3/3 problem sizes.
experiments.known_qualifications: Advantage established strictly under black-box query model with compiler-synthesized oracles; does not imply wall-clock runtime speedup or universal software-repair advantage.

experiments.primary_result: Statistically significant physical quantum query complexity scaling advantage on N=4..16 qubits (slope 0.153 vs classical 0.696, t = -30.65, p = 3.47e-7).
experiments.known_qualifications: Advantage established under the query complexity model for the tested dynamic black-box oracle family; does not imply wall-clock runtime speedup or general quantum advantage.

experiments.primary_result: Qubit reuse compiler reduced register footprint by median 78.1% (up to 87.5% on N=16) with 4/6 reuse wins and 6/6 non-inferior cases on physical observable RMSE.
experiments.known_qualifications: Scope limited to streaming and sequential liveness-compatible circuits; does not claim arbitrary 16-qubit algorithms run on 2 qubits.

experiments.primary_result: 332,768 physical QPU samples across 4 jobs sampled 65,138 unique candidate states, producing 93 verifier-backed positive code repair records (1.59 MB, ~417k token-equivalent) with 100% QPU provenance.
experiments.known_qualifications: Feasibility demonstration only. Current bottleneck is classical verification (158 evaluated of 65k QPU states). Downstream LLM fine-tuning and model improvement were NOT tested.

experiments.primary_result: 18/18 valid compilations across MQT suite; physical execution shows mixed competitiveness (disfavored vs Qiskit by -0.0067, favored vs TKET by +0.0398 driven by vqe_su2_n8).
experiments.known_qualifications: Advantage over TKET is sensitive to vqe_su2_n8 (+0.2696 delta); without vqe_su2_n8, mean delta vs TKET is -0.0062. Q-Psi is disfavored vs Qiskit O3 (-0.0067 delta).

experiments.primary_result: Dynamic routing compressed 2Q depth from 73 to 2 on 13 hops; unitary routing won on short/medium distances (2/2 confirmed predictions); empirical physical crossover was not resolved.
experiments.known_qualifications: No physical Bell fidelity crossover observed due to reset and measurement noise; unitary routing remains physically superior for D<=7.

experiments.primary_result: 4/4 exact optimum hits on small compiler graphs (N<=10), matching classical branch-and-bound; degraded to 0/4 hits on N=18..25 due to hardware noise.
experiments.known_qualifications: Exact classical optimum parity achieved only for small graphs (N<=10); large instances degraded under NISQ noise. No quantum advantage claimed.

experiments.primary_result: Initial feasibility demonstration of physical QPU selector on M=1024 space yielding 14 verified unique code repair records.
experiments.known_qualifications: Proof-of-concept run; superseded by V2 120-Qsec campaign.

experiments.primary_result: Q-Psi calibration layout achieved 1 win, 2 losses, 3 inconclusive vs Qiskit O3 best-of-8 baseline (mean delta -0.0106); hypothesis NOT SUPPORTED.
experiments.known_qualifications: Rigorous negative result preserved. Qiskit multi-seed layout search remains competitive or superior on IBM Heron r2.

experiments.primary_result: Fractional pulse gate lowering achieved structural duration reduction and 2/6 physical wins (N4_B, N8_B), with 4/6 inconclusive cases; classified as mixed physical signal.
experiments.known_qualifications: Structural pulse duration compression does not translate to universal physical fidelity advantage across all workloads.

experiments.primary_result: Selective Pauli twirling twirled only 41.1% of CZ layers on IBM Directed Execution beta mode; achieved 1 win vs unmitigated RAW baseline; comparison vs full twirling was inconclusive.
experiments.known_qualifications: Evaluated on IBM Directed Execution beta mode; selective vs full non-inferiority was inconclusive across tested circuits.

experiments.primary_result: 6/12 instances recovered on physical hardware (N=8..28) with polynomial query reductions, but recovery failures at higher N due to noise prevent establishing asymptotic speedup.
experiments.known_qualifications: Inconclusive asymptotic physical speedup due to NISQ decoherence failures on large N (6/12 recovered overall).

experiments.primary_result: Exploratory demonstration of 5-qubit static Bernstein-Vazirani and state preparation on physical hardware.
experiments.known_qualifications: Exploratory early calibration experiment only; no algorithmic advantage claim.

experiments.primary_result: Deterministic changed-file state compiler achieved 98.4% candidate reduction with zero ground truth leakage on developmental benchmark universe.
experiments.known_qualifications: Evaluated on developmental benchmark universe; baseline pruning study.

experiments.primary_result: Protocol and multi-backend compiled circuits frozen; physical QPU execution not executed.
experiments.known_qualifications: Protocol prepared — physical study incomplete. Excluded from completed physical evidence totals.
experiments.addendum_note: Protocol frozen 18-Aug-2026; QPU execution completed and audited in post-freeze addendum 20-Aug-2026.
